idea: Browser extension that reads any webpage aloud in the voice of a historical figure the user picks, using a small on-device text-to-speech model, no cloud calls, free tier limited to 10 minutes per day.
source: hand-authored by Claude Sonnet 5, offline in this session, by-layer Slicer variant -- see foundry/tools/slicer.yaml

pieces.text: An on-device text-to-speech model exists and is licensable for use inside a browser extension.
Browser extension APIs allow local, non-cloud audio synthesis at latency acceptable for reading a page aloud.
Historical-figure voice packs can be produced or licensed without infringing likeness or IP rights.
Users will find hearing pages read in a historical figure's voice genuinely useful, not just a novelty that wears off.
A free tier capped at 10 minutes/day is enough usage to drive meaningful conversion to a paid tier.
